files.changes: Kept scoped contribution storage, ordered assembly, complete-section enforcement, tool ordering and strict rendering; replaced Schemastery with explicit zod parsing and removed the upstream Harness identity plus PTC/approval/shell/jobs/host-specific placement policy.

Retained dynamic section/context evaluation, deterministic ordering, variable failures, complete prompt and contribution disposal; omitted repository-specific built-in placement inventory and invariant companion tests.
Retained scoped shadowing and owner-dispose withdrawal through the project-owned single scope baseline; removed Agent-shaped and application-policy fixtures.
Retained explicit rest-slot ordering and configuration failure semantics; omitted restricted-agent fixtures owned by the full tools runtime.

Extracted definition registration/freezing, inherited restriction views, schema projection, native invocation, cancellation-after-quiescence, final content normalization and canonical failure/result materialization; removed PTC/code-runtime/SDK rendering, approval and pre/post/around policy, Agent/Session/Loop coupling, settings, timeout/concurrency policy metadata and host tools.

Kept JSON-value authoring DSL, iterative compilation, inference, defineTool argument guards, final content transform and soft replay presenters; redirected shared types, removed unconsumed timeout/concurrency options and deep-froze completed definitions.
Kept the enforced JSON Schema subset and stack-safe schema/value walks unchanged apart from local shared-type imports.
Kept provider-neutral pure call/result presentation vocabulary; redirected ContentBlock to the local LLM source baseline and imported no concrete UI or host tool.
Retained required/optional inference, parameter compilation and fail-before-body behavior; reduced exhaustive author-form cases to the selected public boundary.
Retained unsupported-keyword rejection, object-root guard, aggregated diagnostics and deep stack-safe validation; omitted redundant exhaustive hostile-object cases.
Retained global/scoped shadowing, inherited restrictions, own-definition exemption and Cordis owner disposal; removed Agent/Session, PTC mode and policy event fixtures.

Retained native success, detached/frozen definitions, invalid argument/output, body/render/finalizer failure, final content replacement and abort-before-dispatch semantics; removed approval, pre/post/around waterfall, Session context, Loop, timeout/concurrency and PTC cases.
